key_value_text.value: Consistent with no oscillation; RAA optimum point excluded with confidence level higher than 90%

name: Sterile neutrino search at NEOS Experiment

significance.quote: excluded with a confidence level higher than 90%

summary.plain: NEOS compared the antineutrino spectrum from its eight-month run at 24 metres from a commercial reactor with the prediction for oscillation to a sterile neutrino and found no oscillation. It excluded the best-fit point of the reactor antineutrino anomaly at better than 90 per cent confidence.
summary.technical: Spectral shape of 1976 IBD events/day (S/B ~ 22) consistent with no oscillation; excess near 5 MeV prompt energy as in longer-baseline experiments; sin^2(2 theta_14) below 0.1 for 0.2 < delta m^2_41 < 2.3 eV^2 and the RAA optimum excluded at > 90 % CL.

title: Sterile neutrino search at NEOS Experiment
why_it_matters: An early short-baseline test of the sterile-neutrino explanation of the reactor antineutrino anomaly at a commercial reactor.
